change: Independent synthetic calculations and a public-method inventory are added to distinguish arithmetic checks from unresolved engineering qualification. Stale calculation-package imports are corrected so the public functions can be used.

Qualification is restricted to tested symbols, the incidental-pressure output mislabel is disclosed, and provenance is limited to executed sources and dedicated evidence so unrelated source edits do not stale the report. The reserved scratch option becomes optional and the compact layout choice is explained.

Output validation rejects unrelated checkout destinations and linked targets before calculation or writing. The inventory rebuild test is named explicitly, and revision B is dated to its introducing commit.

Output aliases are validated by their resolved destination, and external directories must be empty or contain only recognised report deliverables before replacement. Link tests handle unavailable privileges, and the change panel displays the latest revision.

Recognised report files with cloud placeholder metadata can be rebuilt while symbolic links and directory junctions remain rejected. Scratch containment uses the resolved checkout root so checkout aliases retain the same restriction.

Deliverable protection rejects every name-surrogate reparse tag, including WSL symbolic links, while retaining cloud placeholder rebuilds. Inventory evidence now covers public async functions and methods as well as synchronous declarations.
